text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Pakistan's president invites President Saddam Hussein to attend a meeting of the Islamic Conference Organisation in Islamabad.
-Foreign ministry spokesman says Arab League secretary- general has lost his neutrality
- Oil minister says the flow of Iraqi oil brought stability to oil markets.
- Editorial says Israel's building of new settlements in Jerusalem was tantamount to an aggression on Arab nation
- Representatives of 40 French firms visit Iraq on Sunday.
- Uday Saddam Hussein receives Iraqi ambassador to Libya.
- Foreign minister starts talks with members of the U.N. Security Council.
- Greek businessmen in Iraq seeking trade deals.
